config.graph_embedding: fixed physical message aggregation plus train-only learned 32-dimensional PCA; no large GNN
config.ncm: one Transformer decoder block, width 32, four attention heads; 1/2/4 residual codes
config.matched_features: both graph and non-graph models receive the same CNN embeddings and seven measured frequency bands
config.compute_control: equal updates plus supported-operation training-FLOP matching to the largest 16-epoch NCM budget
config.gate: unchanged frozen conventional-reference route and acceptance masks from hierarchy_results
config.selection: fixed budgets and validation-only temperatures; no test checkpoint selection
